MIXED PREFILL+DECODE campaign (user 2026-09-27, follow-up #4). One KDA decoder layer, one B200 rank of the cookbook TP8/EP8 recipe. Points `B,L,mx[p

]` = B decode requests at context L (one token each) batched with ONE chunked-prefill chunk of C new tokens on a P-token cached context, exactly as the production scheduler's mixed chunk (prefill rows first, decode rows as 1-token extends; the eager runner runs MIXED as EXTEND). Primary: 64 decode @8k + a 16,384-token first chunk; secondaries: 128 decode @8k + a 4,096-token first chunk, and 64 decode @8k + a 16k chunk at prefix 49,152. Metric = eager step time (mixed batches are never graph-captured). Correctness = row-wise prefill rule over all C+B output rows + post-step state (KDA conv/recurrent state of all requests; MLA written fp8 KV rows: the chunk rows and each decode request's new row). Oracle: VibeSim mixed-batch prediction (decode group + prefill chunk in one case). GPU mode: slurm.

render.METRIC: eager step latency of one Kimi-K3 KDA decoder layer on MIXED prefill-chunk + decode batches
render.MODEL_NAME: Kimi-K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3): one KDA (linear-attention) decoder layer, as it runs on one B200 of the production TP8/EP8 deployment (12 attention heads, 112 local mxfp4 experts, bf16 recurrent state)
render.WORKLOAD: mixed batches (ForwardMode.MIXED, run as EXTEND): B=64 decode requests at context 8,192 (one new token each) batched with one 16,384-token first prefill chunk (primary: 16,448 tokens per step; the MoE sees ~33k local rows, the decode rows ride along as 1-token extends and carry their recurrent state through the chunked scan), plus B=128 decode @8k with a 4,096-token chunk, and B=64 decode @8k with a 16k chunk at prefix 49,152 (must not regress)
render.REBUILD_CMD: find /sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; cd /workspace/opt_run && python3 /tmp/kimi_single_layer_decode.py --point 1,8192,mx1024 --attn-type kda --moe-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --attn-heads 12 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --experts 112 --ep 8 --local-topk 2 --hidden-scale 1.0 --cuda-graph --iters 5 --warmup 2 --bf16-gemm-init --flashinfer-autotune && echo LAYER_SMOKE_OK
